links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT-4o answers with textbook and expert consensus on femoral neck/trochanteric fracture questions
links.effect: Only partial agreement with textbook (mean similarity 0.88; Cohen's Kappa 0.16) and expert opinion (Kappa 0.16); discrepancies in arthroplasty age thresholds and nail length, suggesting outdated sources.
links.quote: Discrepancies were noted in age thresholds for arthroplasty and preferred nail length in subtrochanteric fractures, suggesting reliance on outdated sources.

links.outcome: Output reproducibility across repeated sessions measured by cosine similarity
links.effect: High internal consistency across repeated sessions (mean cosine similarity 0.94-0.98).
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated high internal consistency (mean cosine similarity: 0.94-0.98) but only partial agreement with textbook content (mean similarity: 0.88; Cohen's Kappa: 0.16) and expert opinion survey (Cohen's Kappa: 0.16).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o's performance, consistency, and agreement against textbook standards and expert opinions on orthopedic trauma questions without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
